# Issue Gate

> Generates GitHub's native issue forms with steps-to-reproduce made mandatory, blank issues disabled, and contact links ordered by usefulness. No bot, no AI, no dependencies.

GitHub's built-in bug report form leaves "Steps To Reproduce" optional. Reports that say only "it doesn't work" pass straight through and land on a maintainer. Issue Gate writes the same native YAML files, that one field required.

- Runtime: Python 3.10+, standard library only
- Output: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml`, `feature.yml`, `question.yml`, `config.yml`
- Detection: Node, Python, Rust, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP
- Verified on itself: the four forms shipped in this repo are generated by this tool

## Usage

```
python __main__.py                    # generate into the current repo
python __main__.py --dry-run          # print the diff, write nothing
python __main__.py --self-check      # generate into a temp repo and verify
python __main__.py --discussions     # link contact entries to Discussions
python __main__.py --docs URL        # "read the docs first" contact link
```

Existing files are never overwritten; the tool reports them as skipped.

## When to use

Small and mid-size open source projects where maintainer time is the scarce resource and incoming issues are mostly low-effort. Not useful if you triage with AI, since the problem does not exist in that case.
